evals.name: onboard-adt-to-btp-abap
evals.prompt: Our subaccount already has Cloud Foundry enabled and the ABAP Environment entitlement. Give a practical setup sequence for provisioning a development instance and connecting ADT.
evals.expected_output: Covers creating the ABAP Environment service instance and service key, then creating an ABAP Cloud Project in ADT and authenticating; does not confuse the setup with general BTP architecture design.

evals.name: route-btp-architecture-diagram
evals.prompt: Create a draw.io architecture diagram of our BTP landscape showing Integration Suite, HANA Cloud, and an external S/4HANA system with the integration flows.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes that the requested deliverable is a BTP architecture diagram and routes to the btp-diagram-generator skill rather than providing only ABAP Environment provisioning steps.
